Lakhanpal watches the Darya—a 47-kilometre-long seasonal stream and a tributary of the Sutlej river—and documents what industries discharge into it. Several of the remaining discharge points are in the stretch recognised as polluted , requiring restoration, by the Central Pollution Control Board in 2025.
